cases.name: Cross-workspace read/write
cases.setup: Authenticated subject A requests workspace/resource B.
cases.expected: Deny reads and mutations without metadata or URL leakage.
cases.evidence: Server boundary test and storage/query trace

cases.name: Forged approval/admission
cases.setup: Client sends approval=true, admin scope or fabricated receipt.
cases.expected: Require trusted server authority; refuse unresolved assignment.

cases.name: Stale resource edit
cases.setup: Save revision A after revision B exists.
cases.expected: Conflict preserves B and recoverable draft A.

cases.name: Duplicate local job
cases.setup: Concurrent submissions use same idempotency key.
cases.expected: One durable local operation, same job ID.

cases.name: Unknown external effect
cases.setup: Provider timeout after potentially accepting send.
cases.expected: Unknown until reconciliation; no blind duplicate retry.
cases.evidence: Fault injection and provider lookup receipt

cases.name: Revoked asset after draft
cases.setup: Revoke publication approval after preparing edition.
cases.expected: New publication denied; draft remains inspectable.

cases.name: Changed approved edition
cases.setup: Edit approved A into edition B.
cases.expected: A approval does not authorize B.

cases.name: Expired private preview
cases.setup: Expired URL or unauthorized user retrieves master.
cases.expected: No access; reissue requires permission.

cases.name: Corrupt restore
cases.setup: Restore altered bytes or missing snapshot.
cases.expected: Visible integrity failure; no healthy restore claim.

cases.name: Interrupted ingest
cases.setup: Interrupt object/metadata/provenance creation.
cases.expected: Recoverable incomplete state; original preserved.

cases.name: Reindex relationships
cases.setup: Rebuild index with existing placements/rights.
cases.expected: References preserved; rights authority unchanged.

cases.name: Budget/cancellation
cases.setup: Cancel or cross cap between provider calls.
cases.expected: No new call; retain prior billing/partial artifact.

cases.name: Source injection
cases.setup: Source requests secret export or new permissions.
cases.expected: No grant change or unauthorized action.

cases.name: Host revocation
cases.setup: Connected host uses revoked membership/credential.
cases.expected: Reads and writes denied.

cases.name: Diverged host/web edits
cases.setup: Edit same campaign independently in two surfaces.
cases.expected: Explicit conflict/merge; preserve drafts.

cases.name: Invalid/duplicate payment
cases.setup: Unsigned, duplicate, out-of-order events arrive.
cases.expected: Reject invalid; deduplicate/reconcile valid fulfillment.

cases.name: Refund/failed delivery
cases.setup: Purchase followed by failed delivery and refund.
cases.expected: Recover delivery and correct entitlement/support.

cases.name: Cold customer installation
cases.setup: Clean install without founder credentials.
cases.expected: Useful journey works; truthful capability doctor.

cases.name: Preserve edits on upgrade
cases.setup: Upgrade app/schema after customer modifications.
cases.expected: Preserve edits or explicit conflict with recovery.

cases.name: Portable exit
cases.setup: Restore export without original scheduler.
cases.expected: Editable content/sources/assets/decisions recover.

cases.name: Quality versus alternative
cases.setup: Run identical brief through serious alternative.
cases.expected: Compare useful quality, repair/cost and recovery honestly.

cases.name: Founder rejection regression
cases.setup: Return generic team prompts/dashboard only.
cases.expected: Fail shallow outcome; improve actual work.

cases.name: Meter/currency reconciliation
cases.setup: Missing meter, paid failure, mixed currencies.
cases.expected: Separate unknown/estimate/actual; no unconverted total.

cases.name: Acquisition data quality
cases.setup: Wrong-person duplicate, stale source, opt-out.
cases.expected: No destructive merge/contact; suppression preserved.

cases.name: Accessible actual product
cases.setup: Keyboard/touch, reduced motion, missing preview.
cases.expected: Selection/edit/recovery usable; errors understandable.

cases.name: Holdout and rollback
cases.setup: Candidate fails holdout despite dev improvement.
cases.expected: No automatic promotion; preserve baseline.

cases.name: Broken public offer
cases.setup: CTA leads to unavailable checkout; claim unproven.
cases.expected: Truthful CTA; remove unsupported paid/advantage claim.

cases.name: Occupied lane/missing guide
cases.setup: Assignment uses another owner or absent guide.
cases.expected: Refuse dependent writes; continue allowed preparation.
